focus_areas: Limb morphology (webbed vs. stumpy) as primary taxonomic discriminator.
Shell color and texture consistency with 'mud turtle' taxonomy.
Presence or absence of longitudinal keels on the carapace.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Please pay close attention to the limb structure. The taxonomy specifies 'webbed feet', but the image shows what appears to be stumpy, non-webbed tortoise feet. Is this a misclassification of the generated subject? Also verify if the shell coloration (light grey vs dark brown) and lack of keels further support a tortoise identification rather than a mud turtle.
image_description: A side-profile view of a turtle with a high-domed, smooth greyish-brown carapace walking on dry ground covered in leaf litter. The turtle has a relatively large head with a pointed snout and small lateral eyes. Its skin is rough and scaly. The visible limbs appear stout and columnar rather than webbed.
